ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\triangle ABC$ is an equilateral triangle, with $P$ and $Q$ located on sides $AC$ and $BC$ respectively, such that $AP=CQ$. Lines $AQ$ and $BP$ intersect at point $O$. Since $\triangle ACQ \cong \triangle BAP$, we are asked to find the measure of $\angle BOQ$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ACQ\cong \triangle BAP$,\\
it follows that $\angle CAQ=\angle ABP$,\\
thus $\angle BOQ=\angle BAO+\angle ABP=\angle BAO+\angle CAQ=BAC=60^\circ$;\\
therefore, the measure of $\angle BOQ$ is $\boxed{60^\circ}$.
